offence_category.quote: for the murder of his Uncle

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 148 and 302/149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860

weapon.correct_value: Kanta and knives used in the assault; country-made pistol carried and fired in the air
weapon.quote: started assaulting him with knives and kanta
weapon.reason: Murder weapons were kanta and knives; the pistol was fired only in the air, not used to kill.

evidence_type.quote: neither any country-made pistol was recovered nor any cartridge, empty or otherwise, recovered
evidence_type.reason: No recovery was made; 'recovery' wrongly listed as evidence type.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned, consistent with 'None'.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: there was an old enmity and for that reason, the accused persons had fatally assaulted Satya Narain
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Old enmity and property-related litigation are stated as the reason for the attack.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted the appellant alongwith three others under Sections 148 and 302/149 IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted the appellant under ss.148 and 302/149 IPC.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence affirmed; appeal dismissed
high_court_outcome.quote: a division bench of the High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence of all the accused persons including that of the appellant
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court outcome was stated and was not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.quote: Result of the case: Appeal dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Conviction was upheld and the appeal dismissed.

offence_finally_established.quote: it was a case of murder of the deceased by the other accused persons under Section 302 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 IPC is established per the judgment.

imprisonment_type.quote: imprisonment for life under Section 302/149 IPC
imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment was imposed under s.302/149.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence has no fixed term, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs. 2,000 (fine for conviction under Section 148 IPC, with default stipulation)
fine_rs.quote: to pay fine of Rs. 2,000.00 for the conviction under Section 148 IPC
fine_rs.reason: A fine of Rs. 2,000 is stated, so null is wrong.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused persons assaulted the deceased with kanta and knives; the appellant fired a pistol in the air to frighten witnesses; the deceased died; eyewitness and medical evidence were led.
neutral_facts.quote: The appellant was a part of the unlawful assembly which had the common object of eliminating Satya Narain
neutral_facts.reason: Presents the court's holding on unlawful assembly membership and murder liability as fact, revealing the outcome.

offence_severity.quote: imprisonment for life under Section 302/149 IPC
offence_severity.reason: Sentence of life imprisonment under s.302/149 is stated.

attempt_completion.reason: The murder was completed; the victim died on the spot.

physical_harm.quote: he had received multiple injuries inflicted by knives and kanta
physical_harm.reason: Multiple injuries leading to death are documented.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two offences: Section 148 IPC and Section 302/149 IPC
number_of_offences.quote: convicted the appellant alongwith three others under Sections 148 and 302/149 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Column expects a count; the description does not give one, though the convicted sections are supported.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss from the offence is stated.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Prosecution alleged a plot to kill the deceased; court made no finding on premeditation
premeditation_planning.quote: This was the real intention behind the plot to kill Satya Narain.
premeditation_planning.reason: The State's submission alleges a plot, so 'Not stated' overlooks it, though no court finding exists.

motive.quote: there was an old enmity and for that reason
motive.reason: Motive is old enmity arising from property disposition and litigation.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the appellant has been roped in with the aid of Section 149 IPC
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately states the basis on which the appellant's involvement was accepted.

witness_credibility.quote: their testimony in this regard could not be shaken
witness_credibility.reason: PW-1 and PW-2 are sons of the deceased; their evidence was found unflinching and unshaken.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: State argued the appellant was named as an accused in the 1993 killing of Laxmi Narain
post_offence_conduct.quote: In that case, appellant herein along with others were named as accused.
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment records the State's post-incident conduct argument, so 'Not stated' is inaccurate.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated; only bail refusal is mentioned.

bail_history.quote: On 30.06.2014, this Court granted leave but rejected the prayer for bail.
bail_history.reason: Bail rejection by this Court is stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 08.09.1992; trial judgment 20.01.1997; High Court judgment 27.09.2012; Supreme Court judgment 04.09.2024 (dates only, no duration)
trial_duration.quote: judgment and order dated 20.01.1997 passed in Sessions Trial No. 17 of 1993
trial_duration.reason: Dates are supported, but the field asks for duration and gives a list of dates.

legal_representation.quote: P. K. Jain, Saurabh Jain, S.P. Singh Rathore
legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellant and respondents are listed as stated.

investigation_status.quote: he had submitted the chargesheet on 13.10.1992
investigation_status.reason: FIR registered, chargesheet filed and trial completed are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Lacunae: scribe Kuldeep and Laxmi Narain not examined; no recovery of pistol or cartridges

procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment notes prosecution lacunae, contradicting 'None noted'.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted (1997); High Court affirmed conviction and dismissed appeal (2012); Supreme Court dismissed appeal (2024)
appeal_history.quote: a division bench of the High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence
appeal_history.reason: Trial court convicted rather than 'upheld' the conviction; the rest is correct.

prosecution_argument.quote: PW-1 and PW-2, categorically stated that appellant was carrying a country-made pistol from which he fired in the air
prosecution_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the State's arguments on the pistol, overt act, and motive.

defence_argument.quote: neither were there any firearm injuries on the person of the deceased
defence_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the defence points on injuries, recovery, non-examination and suspicion.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Section 149 IPC creates a constructive or vicarious liability of the members of the unlawful assembly
legal_principle_applied.reason: Accurately states the vicarious liability principle applied.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Krishnappa Vs. State of Karnataka; Vinubhai Ranchhodbhai Patel Vs. Rajivbhai Dudabhai Patel; Yunis alias Kariya Vs. State of M.P.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: All three cases are cited in the judgment as relied upon.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Trial court imposed life under s.302/149 and two years RI under s.148; this Court held the charges proved and upheld the conviction
sentencing_rationale.quote: the trial court had rightly convicted the appellant under Section 148 IPC read with Section 302/149 IPC
sentencing_rationale.reason: The sentence was imposed by the trial court, not for the final decision; the reasoning on proof is correct.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment does not expressly list aggravating factors for sentencing.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Co-accused Shree Dev convicted under ss.147 and 302/149 IPC, sentenced to two years RI and life imprisonment

other_sentence_order.reason: Sentences of co-accused Shree Dev are stated, so 'None' is incomplete.
